config.selection_rule: Freeze parameters after pilot, then run all four profiles on all 20 known calibration seeds and all 20 unseen validation seeds. Never replace a rejected seed, use fallback, edit Module content, or lower the three-path/six-reward/32-growth requirements. PASS requires static audit plus all shape/goal gates.
config.interpretation: Validation seeds are not used for tuning. Observed pass rates and deterministic signatures quantify stability; they do not guarantee every seed or certify Godot physics.
